tasks.short: Respond to requests from offices and the public.

steps.what: Pull the published record the request names.
Respond to requests from municipalities or officials.
Send the reply to the requesting office.

tasks.design: When a request names a published record, {DOCS} pulls that extract and nothing beyond it. The registry clerk writes the reply where the record is silent, including requests from other municipalities or legislative offices, and sends it. The screen does not decide what an office is allowed to receive. A request that names no record waits for the clerk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Every request was retyped from the archives even when the record was already public.
tasks.enabler_now: A named public record can be attached. Judging what else may be said stays with the clerk.
tasks.still_hard: Offices ask for records that are closed, and the boundary is a legal one.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk knows which file is public and which request would expose a party.

ambition.what: Answer a small municipal office that today waits behind the large ones, when the request names a published record.

tasks.altitude: Named public records go out faster. The clerk still decides a request the record does not answer, and still signs the reply.

reach.task: Hand over an item only to the person the record names.
reach.learn: A named public record can be pulled. Deciding a closed file stays with this clerk.

evidence.claim: A store can return a record by its id. It cannot decide that a closed file may be sent.
Sending a record about a person can have a legal effect. The clerk sends the reply. The job digest says a machine chat must identify itself; this reply is the clerk's.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The desk is a European municipal court registry and licensing counter. The sentence uses US public-sector wording and is read as the local court, council, or permit this municipality actually issues.

Fields: Record id and a public flag, produced by the records screen. The request must name the record id. A closed flag stops the pull. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the clerk finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing public-record view before a new portal.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the clerk.
unknowns: Which records are public under national rules.
Which offices may receive a closed file with a legal basis.
research_questions: What share of requests name a record id?

already_counted.description: The clerk still writes replies the record does not cover.
The clerk still sends the reply.

incremental.description: The clerk updates the public-flag list when a rule changes.

approvals.approved_version: record id and the reply text shown to the clerk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If requests rarely name a record, the clerk still searches and the saving stays near the low end. Named public records keep the high end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Maintain the office tracking system for correspondence.
Set the follow-up date from the tracking rule.
Coordinate the follow-up action with the owner.

tasks.design: Incoming correspondence is logged in {WORKFLOW} with a sender, a date, and a type, and the follow-up date is set from the written rule. The registry clerk coordinates the action with its owner and closes the row or sends it back. The rule does not close a letter by itself. A letter with no sender is not logged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Follow-ups lived in a personal list, so a letter was chased only if one clerk remembered it.
tasks.enabler_now: A letter with a sender and a type can take a date from a written rule. Closing it is still a person.
tasks.still_hard: Some letters belong to two owners, and the rule cannot see that.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk knows which quiet letter is actually urgent in this town.

ambition.what: Look each week at follow-ups on small letters, not only the ones a councillor has asked about.

tasks.altitude: The chase list is no longer one person's memory. The clerk still decides when a follow-up is done.

reach.role: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
reach.task: Route an item from the marks on it.
reach.learn: A type and a date can route a letter. Closing the action stays with this clerk.

evidence.claim: A tracking row can store a sender, a type, and a date from a rule. It should not close the row alone.
This is office tracking of letters, not a score of residents or clerks. The job digest says a fraud-risk system was struck down where it was not transparent, and this task builds no such score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The desk is a European municipal court registry and licensing counter. The sentence uses US public-sector wording and is read as the local court, council, or permit this municipality actually issues.

Fields: Sender, received date, and letter type, produced by the incoming letter. The follow-up rule is a table of type to days. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the clerk finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing work queue before a new tracker.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the clerk.
unknowns: Which types have a written day-count.
research_questions: How many open follow-ups are older than the rule?

already_counted.description: The clerk still closes or returns the follow-up.

incremental.description: The clerk adds a letter type and its day-count.

approvals.approved_version: tracking-row id and the close-or-return choice shown to the clerk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If many letters have no sender or no type, they stay on the clerk's desk and the saving falls toward the low end. Clean types keep the high end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research the municipal archives on request.

steps.what: List archive boxes that match the request terms.
Research information in the municipal archives.
Mark the page that answers the citizen.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} catalogue lists archive boxes whose index terms match the request. The registry clerk researches the municipal archives in those boxes and marks the page that answers a public official or a private citizen. The index does not answer the question. A request with no usable term is not searched by the screen.
tasks.previous_blocker: The only index was the clerk who had worked in the archive for years.
tasks.enabler_now: Box-level index terms can narrow the search. Reading the page stays physical and judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Old handwriting, unindexed boxes, and questions that use today's words for an old event.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk recognises an old street name or a council committee the index calls something else.
tasks.altitude: The clerk walks fewer wrong aisles. The research, and what may be told to a citizen, stay with the clerk.

reach.task: Find an item from the catalogue and bring the item, not a guess.
reach.learn: An index can list boxes. The page that answers is still read by this clerk.

evidence.claim: An index can list boxes that share a term. It cannot read an unindexed page.
What a citizen may be shown from a personal record is a legal limit. The clerk marks the page. The search builds no profile of the requester.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The desk is a European municipal court registry and licensing counter. The sentence uses US public-sector wording and is read as the local court, council, or permit this municipality actually issues.

Fields: At least one index term, produced by the request. Box id and term, produced by the archive index. No term means no list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the clerk finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing archive index before scanning every page.
unknowns: How much of the archive is indexed to box level.
Which records a private citizen may see.
research_questions: What share of boxes have index terms?
Who approves release of a personal record?

already_counted.description: The clerk still reads the archives.
The clerk still marks the answering page.

incremental.description: The clerk adds an index term when a box is newly labelled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If most boxes have no index terms, the clerk still walks the aisle and the saving stays near the low end. A box-level index keeps the high end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare documents from the court proceeding outcomes.

loop.input: the judge's outcome fields and the outcome template
loop.check: every sentence cites an outcome field
loop.stop: stop when an outcome field is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative uses the court's sentences, which are not a single fixed cell

steps.what: Check the draft against the judge's outcome.
File the signed record of the court proceedings.

tasks.design: A draft in {DOCS} is prepared only from the outcome fields the judge already signed. The registry clerk checks that draft against the outcome, and {WORKFLOW} files it after that check. The draft does not invent a result. An empty outcome field stops the paper and the clerk writes that part.
tasks.previous_blocker: The clerk typed the outcome from memory of the hearing, and errors were found when parties read the paper.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed outcome with fields can fill a template. The clerk still matches the paper to the outcome.
tasks.still_hard: Oral outcomes that were never written down have no fields.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk notices a template sentence that softens or hardens what the judge said.
tasks.altitude: Clear outcomes become papers without a full retype. The clerk still owns the check against the judge's words.

reach.task: Prepare a note from the fields a professional already recorded.
reach.learn: The professional's words stay the source. This clerk still checks the court paper.

evidence.claim: A template can assemble sentences that each cite an outcome field. An empty field cannot be guessed.

The job digest says administration of justice is high-risk from 2 December 2027, while a narrow procedural draft falls outside it. This paper copies the judge's outcome. The clerk does not decide the proceeding.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The desk is a European municipal court registry and licensing counter. The sentence uses US public-sector wording and is read as the local court, council, or permit this municipality actually issues.

Fields: Case id, outcome type, and the outcome sentences, produced by the judge's signed minute. Empty sentence fields stop the draft. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the clerk finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the court's existing outcome template before writing a new one.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the clerk.
unknowns: Whether minutes are signed before the clerk drafts.
Who may file the record besides this clerk.
research_questions: What share of outcomes are already fields?
Which template sentences drift from the judge's words?

already_counted.description: The clerk still checks the draft against the outcome.

incremental.description: The clerk revises a template sentence when the court changes its wording.

approvals.approved_version: outcome-field ids and the draft text shown to the clerk
accepted draft id about to be filed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If outcomes are still oral, the clerk writes the paper and the saving stays near the low end. Signed outcome fields keep the high end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The clerk still researches the archives and answers requests the record does not cover. Tracking dates and routine outcome papers leave the hour.
reach: Library assistants search a catalogue and fetch the item, and this desk learns when the catalogue is not the answer.
Postal clerks record where an item is, and this desk learns that a follow-up date is not the reply itself.
skills_to_grow: Answer from the record that was asked for, and stop when the record is silent.
Check an outcome paper against the judge's note before it is filed.
role.ambitious_version: A named record is pulled the same day for another office, and an archive search that needs judgement still waits for the clerk.
